title: UG-023 — How to prefill matrix questions with URL parameters
intent: Explain the special syntax for matrix questions.
short_answer: For matrix questions, use the identifier of the relevant matrix row or sub-question, not the identifier of the entire matrix question. Assign the answer identifier to each matrix row identifier.
important_conditions: The entire matrix identifier is not sufficient for selecting individual matrix answers.
